user.title: Better Media Player
user.description:
Sets up Better Media Player's central entry. Rooms are set up and changed in the panel [Better Media Player]({panel}) in the sidebar.

Follow me: the music follows the people from room to room. Choose the follow-me player, a Music Assistant group player with dynamic members (empty: no follow me). It can be changed in the panel too.

data_description.follow_player: A Music Assistant group player with dynamic members; empty: no follow me.

error.not_a_group: That is no Music Assistant group player.

abort.use_panel: Better Media Player is set up. Rooms are set up and changed in the panel [Better Media Player]({panel}) in the sidebar.
abort.already_configured: Better Media Player is set up.
abort.already_in_progress: Better Media Player is already being set up.

create_entry.default: Now set up your rooms in the panel [Better Media Player]({panel}) in the sidebar.

set_sleep_timer.name: Set sleep timer
set_sleep_timer.description: Turn the room off after the given time; the volume fades out over the last minutes and is restored for the next playback.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Time until the room turns off (replaces a running timer).

fade_minutes.name: Fade-out
fade_minutes.description: Minutes of fade-out before the end; default from the room's settings.

cancel_sleep_timer.name: Cancel sleep timer
cancel_sleep_timer.description: Stop the sleep timer; a running fade-out is undone.

wake.name: Wake up
wake.description: Power the room, start playback quietly and fade it in. Fails (event) if nothing plays within 60 s.

media_content_id.name: Media
media_content_id.description: What to play; picked through the room player, it also chooses the player.

start_volume.name: Start volume
start_volume.description: 0..1 (e.g. 0.05) or a preset of the room. Default 0.05.

target_volume.name: Target volume
target_volume.description: 0..1 or a preset of the room. Default: the room volume.

fade_minutes.name: Fade-in
fade_minutes.description: Minutes from start to target volume; default 10.

max_duration_minutes.name: Maximum duration
max_duration_minutes.description: Afterwards the sleep timer fades out and turns the room off.

night_mode.name: Night mode
night_mode.description: Turn the night mode on or off before; empty: unchanged.

source.name: Player
source.description: For media not picked through the room player; default: the music player.

follow.name: Follow me
follow.description: The music follows you from this room (needs central settings and occupancy sensors here).

snooze.name: Snooze
snooze.description: Pause the wake; afterwards it starts again and fades in.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: Default from the room's times (9 min).

stop_wake.name: Stop wake
stop_wake.description: End the wake; the playback goes on.

start_follow.name: Follow me
start_follow.description: Start follow me in this room: its music moves to the follow-me player and follows the people from now on.

stop_follow.name: Stop follow me
stop_follow.description: End follow me: the music stays in this room if it plays along, else goes back to the room it was started in; the other rooms stop.

set_volume_preset.name: Set volume preset
set_volume_preset.description: Set the room's volume to one of its presets.

fade_seconds.name: Fade
fade_seconds.description: Seconds to fade to the preset (0: at once). Default: the room's preset fade.

handover.name: Hand over
handover.description: Continue what plays in this room in another room: the other room powers up, the playback goes on there (music: the queue with the position of the current track; video: Better Kodi's handover), this room goes off.

destination.name: Destination
destination.description: The room player of the room to continue in.

keep_source_playing.name: Keep playing here
keep_source_playing.description: This room plays on (only where the player's system can: Better Kodi).

announce.name: Announce
announce.description: An announcement in one or more rooms, over what plays there: the room picks the player, wakes its devices if it is off and holds still meanwhile. Rooms that together are a playing group get it once, through the group.

media_content_id.name: Media
media_content_id.description: A sound or recording to play instead of a message.

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: 0..1 or a preset of the room. Default: the player system's (Music Assistant: its announcement volume); at night at most the night mode's limit.

ignore_quiet.name: Also in quiet rooms
ignore_quiet.description: For emergencies: quiet rooms get it too.

pre_announce.name: Chime
pre_announce.description: A chime before the announcement (default: the player's setting).

set_setting.name: Set a setting
set_setting.description: Changes a setting of a room, of one of its devices, or a central one. It takes effect at once and is kept.

entity_id.name: Room
entity_id.description: The room's player. Leave empty for a central setting.

device.name: Device
device.description: A device of the room (its id, e.g. display, or its name), for a device's setting.

setting.name: Setting
setting.description: The setting's key, e.g. night_max_volume, run_down, default_volume. The list is in the documentation (Reference).

value.name: Value
value.description: A number, true / false, or one of the setting's choices.

get_settings.name: Get the settings
get_settings.description: Returns the settings of a room and its devices, or the central ones (as the action's response).

entity_id.name: Room
entity_id.description: The room's player. Leave empty for the central settings.

device.name: Device
device.description: Only this device of the room (its id or name).

options.player_off: {name} is off: its library appears once it is on

room_off.message: {room} is off - a sleep timer needs a running room.

night_mode_bool.message: night_mode must be true or false.

follow_wake.message: {room} cannot wake with follow me: it needs central settings, a music player and occupancy sensors.

no_follow_player.message: No follow-me player is set up (central settings).

preset_not_offered.message: The preset {preset} is not offered in {room}.

start_not_follow_room.message: {room} takes no part in follow me: it needs a music player and occupancy sensors.

start_quiet.message: {room} is in quiet mode: follow me cannot be started there.

start_video.message: {room} cannot start follow me: the video player ({player}) is on.

start_in_group.message: {room} cannot start follow me: {player} plays in the group {group}. Start the music on {player} itself (not in a group).

start_not_playing.message: {room} cannot start follow me: no music plays on {player}. Start the music on {player} itself.

start_follow_paused.message: {room} cannot start follow me: {player} is still in the follow-me player {group}, which does not play. Resume {group}, or start the music on {player} itself.

handover_not_a_room.message: {destination} is no Better Media Player room.

handover_nothing_playing.message: Nothing plays in {room} that could be handed over.

handover_no_player.message: {destination} has no player to continue what {player} plays.

handover_not_supported.message: {player} cannot hand over to {target} (needs the same system with handover: Music Assistant, Better Kodi).

handover_keep_not_supported.message: {player} cannot play on while handing over (its queue moves).

handover_in_group.message: {player} plays in a group ({group}): hand over the group in Music Assistant, or start the music on {player} itself.

announce_not_supported.message: No player in {room} can play the announcement (a player in a group is left alone).

announce_nothing.message: Give a message or a media_content_id.

announce_no_room.message: No room player of Better Media Player among the targets.

settings_not_a_room.message: {entity} is not a room of Better Media Player.

settings_no_device.message: The room {room} has no device {device} (its devices: {devices}).

settings_needs_device.message: {setting} is a device's setting: give the device as well.

settings_no_central.message: The central entry of Better Media Player is not set up.

settings_needs_room.message: A device ({device}) belongs to a room: give the room's player as well.

trigger_type.run_down_cancelled: Run-down cancelled (needed again or kept on)
trigger_type.run_down_off: Device switched off after its run-down

missing_entities.title: {room}: entities missing

disabled_entities.title: {room}: entities disabled

shared_entities.title: Devices switched by several rooms

group_player.title: {room}: group player as the room's player

follow_player_not_group.title: Follow me: no group player
follow_player_not_group.description: The follow-me player `{entity}` is not a Music Assistant group player. Follow me needs a group player with dynamic members: choose one under **Configure** of the central settings (Settings → Devices & services → Better Media Player).

follow_player_missing.title: Follow me: follow-me player missing
follow_player_missing.description: The follow-me player `{entity}` does not exist (any more) in Home Assistant. Choose a Music Assistant group player with dynamic members under **Configure** of the central settings (Settings → Devices & services → Better Media Player). A renamed entity is followed by itself.

follow_player_disabled.title: Follow me: follow-me player disabled
follow_player_disabled.description: The follow-me player `{entity}` is disabled. Enable it again, or choose another under **Configure** of the central settings (Settings → Devices & services → Better Media Player).

removed_entities.title: {room}: settings now set by an action
